Limits

The request-size and request-rate limits and how they are applied.

Request size

The default ceiling on a request body is 32 MiB. The plan ceiling and the route class's own limit apply too, and the smaller one wins. Over the limit is a 413.

Request rate

The rate limit is applied per workspace first and then per key, with a smooth (GCRA) window. A request over it is a 429 with Retry-After, and it does not wait in a queue. The state is held in each gateway process, so with several replicas each admits up to the configured rate. A workspace on the free door is held to the free-door rate whatever its other limits say.

Free allowance

The request-fee allowance is a count per calendar month; see the BYOK chapter.

Rate-limit headers on every answer are coming with a limiter lane (the gateway's limiter keeps no remaining count to report yet).
